nodes.description: Public token name string stored in contract storage.
Public token symbol string stored in contract storage.
Public uint8 decimals value of the token.
_totalSupply uint256 holding the total minted token supply.
mapping(address => uint) balances recording token ownership.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) allowed for ERC20 allowances.
Constructor initializing name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and crediting msg.sender.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address) returns the balance entry for the given token owner.
allowance(address,address) returns the stored allowance.
approve(address,uint) sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transfer(address,uint) moves tokens from msg.sender to recipient via safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moves tokens on behalf of 'from' and decrements allowance.
External caller-controlled address used as authorization and balance key.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply that can underflow.
State mutation of balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] followed by Transfer event in transfer.
State mutation of balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to] in transferFrom.
tokenOwner address parameter of balanceOf/allowance.
spender address parameter of approve and allowance.
tokens uint parameter representing transfer or approval amount.
to address parameter receiving tokens in transfer/transferFrom.
from address parameter whose tokens are spent in transferFrom.
First operand a of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Second operand b of the SafeMath arithmetic helpers.
Return variable c holding the SafeMath computation result.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining of allowance.
Named return variable success of approve, transfer and transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of the whole initial supply in the constructor.
Constructor assigns the constant total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
totalSupply executes an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply which can underflow.
balances mapping entries can be written under the key msg.sender, making authorization caller dependent.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller controls which balance is reduced.
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender, making the spender key caller controlled.
approve writes the tokens value into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transfer performs its balance mutations and event emission as unsafe_operation node 15.
transferFrom performs its balance and allowance mutations as unsafe_operation node 16.
transfer updates the balances mapping for sender and receiver.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for from, to and spender.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry of the spender.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
spender is the second key written in the allowed mapping by approve.
tokens amount is used in the safeSub and safeAdd calls of transfer.
to address receives the credited balance inside transfer.
from address supplies the debited balance inside transferFrom.
safeAdd/safeSub operand a flows from the balance values used by transfer.
safeAdd/safeSub operand b flows from the tokens amount used by transfer.
SafeMath result c is assigned back into the balances mapping by transfer.
balance is the named return value written by balanceOf.
remaining is the named return value written by allowance.
success is the named return value returned by transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: tokenOwner exists only to index the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
spender is only a key inserted into the allowed mapping by approve.
tokens is the arithmetic amount consumed by transfer's safeSub/safeAdd calls.
to is only used as the destination key written by transfer.
from is only used as the source key consumed by transferFrom.
SafeMath operand a is supplied by the caller's balance inside transfer.
SafeMath operand b is supplied by the tokens amount inside transfer.
SafeMath result c is written straight back into the balances mutation of transfer.
balance is the internal return slot of balanceOf.
remaining is the internal return slot of allowance.
success is the boolean return flag produced by transfer.
